typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Space as string,
		CUValue as double,
		TotalPower as double,
		CU as string,
		TotalCU as double,
		SpaceValue as double,
		SpacePercent as integer,
		PowerPercent as integer,
		TotalSpace as integer,
		InsertTs as timestamp,
		Power as string,
		PowerValue as double,
		CUPercent as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Space as string,
		CUValue as double,
		TotalPower as double,
		CU as string,
		TotalCU as double,
		SpaceValue as double,
		SpacePercent as integer,
		PowerPercent as integer,
		TotalSpace as integer,
		InsertTs as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Power as string,
		PowerValue as double,
		CUPercent as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Space,
		CUValue,
		TotalPower,
		CU,
		TotalCU,
		SpaceValue,
		SpacePercent,
		PowerPercent,
		TotalSpace,
		InsertTs,
		Power,
		PowerValue,
		CUPercent),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
